sourceOfTruth: This JSON is the source of truth. The prose lens in skills/software-development/critic-lens-ux/SKILL.md is a human readable view; checklist-lint rejects duplicate IDs and SARIF ruleIds that do not resolve here. Panel machinery items (annex application, capture-recapture, inter-rater reliability, decorrelation, seed calibration, unknowns ledger, Not tested list, write gate, environment levels) are carried in the code checklist as CODE-PM-001 through CODE-PM-009 and are part of every brief, whatever lens leads.
